description: This file defines a class 'EditEmployeeAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It configures menu settings for the 'viewAttendanceRecord' screen within the 'time' module of the OrangeHRM attendance plugin, overriding module and screen identifiers.

classes.name: EditEmployeeAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu settings for editing employee attendance records, specifically setting module and screen context for the attendance view screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module to 'time' and the screen to 'viewAttendanceRecord' within the attendance plugin context.
